description.value: The AMS Nest is the student union building of UBC Vancouver, operated by the Alma Mater Society — Canada's largest student union, founded in 1915. Situated at the heart of the UBC campus, it is a multi-storey community hub housing restaurants, shops, event spaces, and student support services, making it a natural gathering point for cyclists exploring the UBC endowment lands. The building hosts a lively year-round calendar of public events and offers a range of food and retail options.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 64m; stands (20 spaces, covered) at 65m; stands (27 spaces) at 84m; stands (14 spaces) at 86m. Total: 71 spaces.
